marks.gloss_en: שנאמר יהיו תמים על ראשו, ולהלן הוא אומר תמו נכרתו -- תם is 'ended', so the beams end [taper] at the top
שנאמר יחדיו -- together, [alike above and below]
R' Yehuda: the beams were a cubit thick below, and above they tapered down to a finger's breadth
אמר שמואל: ביתדות -- Rav spoke of the wagons with the stakes (= p_shmuel_yitedot); Shmuel's answer to the מאי איכא למימר of 98a.4
Shmuel: [Rav spoke of the wagons] with the stakes
והכתיב תמים! -- [against R' Nechemya]
ההוא דליתו שלמין ולא ליתו דניסרא -- [on his view] it teaches that they bring whole [beams] and not patched ones
ואידך נמי, הכתיב יחדו! -- [against R' Yehuda]
ההוא דלא לישלחופינהו מהדדי -- [on his view] it teaches that they not be set askew from one another
בשלמא למאן דאמר ... כך מלמעלן עוביין אמה, היינו דכתיב ... אלא למאן דאמר ... כלין והולכין עד כאצבע, האי עייל והאי נפיק! -- on R' Yehuda's view, at the corners one beam goes in and the other sticks out
דשפי להו כי טורין -- he pared them like mountains
'and for the rear of the Mishkan westward make six beams, and two beams make for the corners' (Ex 26:22-23): the width of these comes and fills the thickness of those
תניא נמי הכי: for R' Yehuda the goat-hair curtains' overhang (Ex 26:13) goes to cover the sockets' cubit, as the stam computed at 98b.8
תניא נמי הכי: for R' Nechemya the overhang goes to cover the beams' cubit, so the sockets' cubit stays exposed, as the stam computed at 98b.8
'and the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side of the overhang' (Ex 26:13) -- to cover the cubit of the sockets: R' Yehuda
אלא לרבי נחמיה מאי תסרח? -- if the overhang goes to cover the beams' cubit, what is the trailing the verse speaks of?
תסרח מחברותיה -- it trails beyond its fellow curtains (= p_rn_tisrach_mechavroteha)
granted for R' Yehuda: that is what is written, 'the half curtain that remains shall trail' (Ex 26:12)
'and the middle bar in the midst of the beams' -- it stood by a miracle
laying the lower curtains' length (28) across the Mishkan's width, less ten for the roof, nine remain on this side and nine on that
laying their width (40) along the Mishkan's length, less thirty for the roof, ten remain
the goat-hair curtains' length (30) across the width, less ten for the roof: ten remain on each side
the beams were grooved and the sockets hollow
